create_MsgProcessor: create a MsgProcessor module with binary message embeddings and concatenation aggregation
build_random_binary_message: build a random binary message tensor for watermark embedding with specified batch size
build_random_gaussian_message: build a normalized random Gaussian message tensor for watermark embedding
apply_message_to_latents: apply a secret message embedding to encoder latents using binary or Gaussian encoding
test_MsgProcessor_forward: test the MsgProcessor forward pass with latents and message tensors for watermark embedding
